notes:
Original frequency result is a descriptive percentage comparison: no effect-size estimate or p value is printed for that comparison in the original paper. Do not import the original Cramer’s V retrospectively calculated/reported in the replication paper. Replication frequency test is on p. 7/Table 1, while supplied locator says p. 8. ResearchGate HTML extraction renders equals signs as ! and chi-square as $; these glyph artifacts are retained in verbatim quote fields. n quotes are compact noncontiguous numeric excerpts from cited rows.
Completion source review (n_r): Explicit final mutually exclusive client groups for the critical test. Valid OQ-45 administrations with more than two data points; individual/group therapy only; other treatment types excluded; first episode only (90-day gap defines new episode); concurrent group/individual therapy excluded; alerts examined during Sessions 2–15.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Requested test statistic printed for the alert-rate comparison.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Exact p accompanies the same test. Source provenance documents ! as equals-sign parse artifact.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly say increased NOT rate replicates original finding.
